content_of_post_to_comment: Stop trying to be consistent. Be devoted. Consistency is for factories. Devotion is for monks, artists, and lovers. If you miss a day, you haven't failed the algorithm. You just took a breath. Come back to the work because you love it, not because you fear losing your streak.
comment: The interesting tension is that devotion still needs rhythm. Maybe the goal isn't abandoning consistency, but letting consistency serve the craft rather than becoming a measure of worth.
